meta title "Set-Off Quotations"
section* 1
  text "Quoting"
para
  text "A paragraph before the quotation keeps the full measure, and is long enough to wrap so the margin either side of the set-off block is visible. The quotation that follows must sit inside both margins."
quote
  para
    text "A short invented epigraph, set off from the text by indenting both margins, long enough to wrap at the narrowed measure it is set to."
para
  text "Prose between the two forms returns to the full measure."
quote
  para
    text "The first paragraph of a longer invented quotation, still indented on both sides and wrapping at the narrowed measure."
  para
    text "The second paragraph of the same quotation follows after a paragraph break and stays inside the same margins."
para
  text "A closing paragraph returns to the full measure."
